players.product: FC-BGA and BT package substrates (Guangzhou plant) for processor, memory and PMIC chips

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply (half-year report): driven by AI compute demand, key raw materials such as copper-clad laminate and glass-fibre cloth showed tightening supply and accelerating price rises, and some downstream customers began placing orders early to secure stable supply. The PCB business faced both material shortages and high output load; the company stocked up on scarce materials, widened its supply channels and optimised scheduling to keep output high. The Thailand plant and Nantong phase 4 (started in 2025) were ramping smoothly overall.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Package substrates in H1 2026 (half-year report): BT memory-substrate orders grew significantly as AI applications sharply raised memory demand; PMIC substrate orders grew significantly as customers' AI power demand ramped; FC-CSP offset weaker phone and consumer demand with non-consumer business; RF product mix improved. The company secured high output and timely delivery by buying materials ahead, coordinating with upstream suppliers and qualifying new materials with customers, and R&D on substrate technology for next-generation advanced computing is progressing.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic assembly in H1 2026: main-business revenue RMB 19.76 hundred million, up 33.70%, 12.92% of revenue; gross margin 17.30%, up 2.32 percentage points. Data-center projects with strategic and new customers entered mass production and the data-center order mix improved; the company is building manufacturing and test capability for next-generation advanced computing and interconnect.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 detail (half-year report): net profit after non-recurring items RMB 2,239,172,474.35, up 76.94%; operating cash flow RMB 1,501,855,888.16, up 0.42%. Domestic sales RMB 8,879,812,107.88 (+49.47%) and overseas sales RMB 5,751,815,905.10 (+47.27%). R&D RMB 858,551,949.19, up 27.81%, 5.61% of revenue. Subsidiaries: Wuxi Guangxin Package Substrate revenue RMB 176,004.83 ten-thousand (net profit RMB 46,775.52 ten-thousand); Guangzhou Guangxin Package Substrate revenue RMB 125,031.99 ten-thousand.
